theorems.name: Submission.poincare_approx_ball_double_integral_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n) (φ : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) r)) → AEStronglyMeasurable g (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) r)) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ j)) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖φ j x - f x‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖gradient (φ j) x - g x‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖f x - f y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (n + 2) * volume (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖g x‖ₑ ^ 2
